title: Regency Wraps Chef-Grade 100% Cotton Cheese Cloth 36"X72" (2yds), Bleach & Dye Free, Food Safe For Cooking, Straining, Roasting Turkey, Durable Cheese Cloths for Crafting, Canning
description:
PROFESSIONAL CHEF-GRADE CHEESECLOTH: Made of durable 100% cotton, our cheese cloths undergo rigorous Lab-testing and comply with strict food safety standards. It's free from metals, bleach, and dyes; safe for all your food prep and household needs.
A STAPLE IN THE KITCHEN: Cheesecloth for cooking turkey, and everything from steaming vegetables, straining soups and sauces to crafting homemade cheese, yogurt, nut milk, and kombucha, this cheese cloth is your ideal culinary companion.
VERSATILE FOR COOKING, PRESERVING AND MORE: A versatile tool for canning fruits, jellies and jams, our straining cloth is ideal for separating solids from liquids when crafting fruit juices and gravy; even keeping fish intact when poaching
CLEANING, CRAFTING & DECORATING: Beyond the kitchen, this lint-free cotton cloth is indispensable for cleaning mirrors, windows, polishing silver, creating decorations like spooky Halloween ghosts and cobwebs; table runners and even lovely curtains.
OVEN SAFE BUT KEEP AWAY FROM FLAME: Can be gently hand washed with soap and water, but single use is recommended to avoid cross contamination. This purchase Supports Small Business: Regency Wraps is family-owned and operated in the USA since 1985
